dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale-colored boundaries on the edges of the dark primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A dark, transverse rectangular patch on the posterior neck area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct and sharp boundary where the uniform brown crown meets the dark nape patch and the patterned mantle.
